goal: Lets an external client validate block templates against the node's real mempool without mirroring it
Removes the need for the Stratum v2 Job Declarator Server to keep a duplicate mempool, saving bandwidth for pool operators
reviewability: Paused: a 10-day-unanswered question about inconsistent reject-reason strings should be resolved before further review on that point
agreement: Strong support from four reviewers with substantive engagement, no objections to the design (ismaelsadeeq, pablomartin4btc, enirox001, jeanpablojp)
Open non-blocking question about reject-reason consistency between two code paths (jeanpablojp)
An alternative interface-split proposal was discussed and agreed to be a style choice, not blocking (ViniciusCestarii)

categories.name: mining
why: P2 because it gives the SV2 Job Declarator Server a way to validate externally built templates against the real mempool
Eliminates a duplicated mirror mempool, a real architectural benefit for pool operators, with a working consumer prototype already built
It is new capability rather than a fix for a template-acceptance bug, so it stops short of P1 despite strong reviewer enthusiasm
